methods.geometry: Last two normalized confirmed HIGHs and LOWs: HH/LL EXPANDING, LH/HL CONTRACTING, HH/HL RISING, LH/LL FALLING; equality separate. This is local geometry, not a stable range/trend classifier.
methods.envelope: Previously frozen trailing15 M1 extrema, excluding last signal candle, from archived decision-time diagnostics; not claimed consolidation bounds.
methods.position: (price-lower)/(upper-lower). Values remain unclamped; <0 below, >1 above. Last closed price and partially formed decision reference price separate.
methods.atr: Width divided by M1 Wilder ATR14; not H1/daily ATR exhaustion.
methods.swing_envelope: min(last two LOWs),max(last two HIGHs); may already be broken and stale, not an executable support/resistance forecast.
methods.causality: Uses saved contemporaneous37 snapshots already raw-verified in previous work. Source fingerprints joined exactly. No raw archive rescan this turn.
methods.touches: No raw ordered touch/sweep/return/acceptance replay. Stable consolidation and breakout confirmation remain UNVERIFIED.
methods.policy: No added filter, probability, entry or PnL simulation; original holdout and all trading settings unchanged.
